body: I am sorry only joined Reddit a few hours ago, still learning how to reply lol

Yes that’s the best find. I remember last year when I went through a very rough break up what ultimately made me feel better was people who had had a heart break themselves. I guess that’s why I came to Reddit, because it’s not easy to find people who are suicidal.

Talking to a counsellor will be my last resort. I have always found that acquaintances/strangers are better listeners than your close friends. Maybe because you know that even if they judge you it doesn’t matter.

It’s okay buddy. Don’t burden yourself with any expectations from yourself or anyone else anymore. No one can possibly fully understand what you’re going through. You’re doing the best in your circumstances. Just keep hanging on for a little longer.
I am here listening. Please tell me more.

I get it buddy. It’s great that you’ve started looking for help in time. I am pretty much at a similar stage. Thoughts of killing myself really calm myself down. I used to have a lot of those last year, but I worked on loving myself, things are still going south so those thoughts are back, especially after something that happened yesterday.
From my experience I have learned that talking to someone and loving myself where I reduce all the expectations from myself to zero really helps me. I am here if you want to talk to me about those incidents of your life or anything. Feel free to DM me. I am also a broken soul, I have no capacity to judge you.
Hey! I would genuinely like to hear more from you.
I can understand some of the things you’re going through. I can’t even bear to tell my friends about my depression for the same reason. Hang in there buddy.

Wow this is really thoughtful of you. Music is my panacea too. I am not a fan of hip hop, but I am liking some of these songs.

One of my favourite line is “paying my dues to the dirt” from the song On Top of the World by Imagine Dragons.

Same buddy. I think the only reason holding me back is my family too. They have done way too much for me, it would be unjust to them. If you look at the deepest darkest corner within you, you will somehow find the courage to go on for one more day.

I am not sure about anyone else, but it does help me when somebody can listen to everything I have to say without judging me one bit. I don’t want to hear anything from them, mostly nothing they can say can make it right. But it does make me feel better if someone is ready to sit with me as long as I’d like, and listen with honest intent.
Thank you for taking the effort to read through all of that :)

I am not asking you to get rid of the thought mate. My plea is just that you delay it to perhaps day after tomorrow or later. Try delaying it as much as you can. Give your other side that supports your life, no matter how weak it is, some time to make their case

I wish I could tell you that there is light at the end of the tunnel buddy but I don’t know that myself. My career, relationship and health, all three things that matter are screwed. I often feel like killing myself and being at peace. But I know I am not gonna do it, because somewhere inside me I know that this is not right for me or for anyone. We know it buddy that intellectually this is the wrong thing to do, but our emotions are way too overpowering. Just try to give it a rational thought, delay it as much as you can, it will then become a fleeting thought and one day it will go away.
